_comment: Company capex guidance (T2: company statement, not audited). Each company defines capex its own way (Meta includes principal payments on finance leases; Microsoft speaks of capex including finance leases; Oracle separates gross capex from net cash capex). Guidance is never mixed into the reported (T1) series. Sources: FactSet guidance dataset (company-provided guidance as FactSet records it, pulled in a Claude session on 2026-10-03) and, for Oracle, the Oracle model's own guidance store (tools/oracle/data/guidance.json, transcribed from the Q1 FY2027 call). US$ millions. Update after each earnings call.

items.note_en: Microsoft gives no annual capex range; FactSet's guidance dataset has none for FY2026 or FY2027.
items.note_es: Microsoft no da un rango anual de capex; el conjunto de guías de FactSet no registra ninguno para el AF2026 ni el AF2027.

items.source: FactSet guidance dataset (CAPEX), guidance dated 2026-07-23 (Q2 2026 results)

items.note_en: Recorded by FactSet as a point figure from the Q4 2025 call. Rechecked 2026-10-03: FactSet's monthly guidance snapshots through 2026-10-01 show no later figure, so this is still the latest guidance on record; Amazon's Q3 2026 call is the next chance to update it.
items.note_es: FactSet lo registra como cifra puntual de la llamada del 4T25. Revisado el 2026-10-03: las instantáneas mensuales de guías de FactSet hasta el 2026-10-01 no muestran cifra posterior, así que sigue siendo la guía más reciente registrada; la llamada del 3T26 de Amazon es la próxima oportunidad de actualizarla.
items.source: FactSet guidance dataset (CAPEX), guidance dated 2026-02-06 (Q4 2025 results)

items.note_en: Meta's capex definition includes principal payments on finance leases.
items.note_es: La definición de capex de Meta incluye los pagos de principal de arrendamientos financieros.
items.source: FactSet guidance dataset (CAPEX), guidance dated 2026-07-30 (Q2 2026 results)

items.note_en: $90-95bn of capex, of which not more than $70bn net cash capex (the rest funded by partners/customers), per the Q1 FY2027 call, p. 4.
items.note_es: US$90-95 mil millones de capex, de los cuales no más de US$70 mil millones de capex neto en efectivo (el resto lo financian socios/clientes), según la llamada del 1T AF2027, p. 4.
